decision_conditions: By reason of scale, bulk and massing, together with the footprint within the site, the proposed two storey building would be unduly prominent and would appear as an incompatible and incongruous addition to the streetscene. The application would therefore be contrary to the objectives of the National Planning Policy Framework, Policy D3 of the London Plan 2021, Policies 1, 28 and 37 of the Local Plan and the Council's Supplementary Planning Document 14.

By virtue of  its scale, size, and intensification of use within this constrained site together with the proximity to neighbouring properties, the proposed development would result in unreasonable levels of noise and other disturbances to the detriment of the amenities of the occupiers of the neighbouring properties. The application would therefore be contrary to the objectives of the National Planning Policy Framework, Policy D14 of the London Plan 2021 and Policy 29 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

Given the site's location and the limited on and off-street parking facilities within the context, the proposed significant increase in vehicular trips to the site would result in overspill car parking to the detriment of the safe and efficient operation of the public highway. The proposed development would therefore be contrary to the objectives of National Planning Policy Framework and Policies 36 and 37 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

Without any evidence to the contrary, the application has failed to demonstrate that the proposed development complies with the 'as designed' simplified building energy model (SBEM). As such, the application would be contrary to Policy SI 2 of the London Plan 2021 and Policy 31 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

In the absence of a completed S106 legal agreement to capture any 'significant onsite habitat gains', the application has failed to demonstrate that the proposed development would achieve a Biodiversity net gain. The proposal is therefore contrary to Policy G6 of the London Plan 2021 and Policy 26 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.
description: Demolition of the existing buildings, erection of a detached two storey building including a basement comprising Class F1 (Place of Worship), installation of solar panels to rear roofslope, provision of new boundary treatments, parking, cycle and refuse storage areas and hard and soft landscaping.
